simple.summary: גְלִילָה (gᵉlîylâh) means a circuit or region First listed occurrence: Ezek 47 8.

definitions.full: H1552. gelilah גְּלִילָה noun feminine circuit, boundary, territory — ׳ג Ezek 47:8 ; plural construct גְּלִילוֺת Josh 13:2 ; 22:10-11 , Joel 4:4; — belonging to a people הַמְּלִשְׁתִּים בָּלגְּֿלִילוֺת 13:2 compare Joel 4:4 ( ג ׳כֹּל לָ֑שֶׁת מְּ ); so ׳ג הַיַּרְדֵּן 22:10-11 , according to some, but see following; absolute Ezek 47:8 ׳הַגּ הַקַּדְמוֺנָה ; as proper name, of a location Galilee , ᵐ5 Γαλιλαια (|| נַפְתָּלִי אֶרֶץ כֹּל ) compare II. גָּלִיל .
